name: Xindong xianchang: Lian'ai shi jing xiu
source:
"Heartbeat House: Hong Kong" is set in a dating reality show. You live with other participants in a shared villa and make romantic choices.

Your decisions matter as you navigate who you choose to date (with 8 characters to potentially date!).  As the cameras roll and everyone is having a great time, something seems off. Maybe it’s just that heart-fluttering feeling as you flirt with everyone…or is it?
